results.title: NIST StRD — Chwirut2 data and certified values
results.content: The NIST ultrasonic-calibration dataset has 54 observations and model y = exp(-b1*x)/(b2+b3*x). The certified parameters are b1=0.16657666537, b2=0.0051653291286, b3=0.012150007096, and certified residual sum of squares is 513.04802941. It provides two starting vectors and labels the problem lower difficulty.
